title: Request data bound wholesale (php) — review required
description: Request data is copied onto an object without a field list: extracts*($_(?:GET|POST|REQUEST). Clients can then set privileged attributes (roles, flags, ownership) the form never showed. This lexical rule flags the binding; the reviewer confirms an allowlist or picks fields explicitly.
remediation: Bind through explicit variable assignment, assigning only listed fields from the request.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches wholesale binding regardless of model guards.
